items.title: The Matrix
items.text: A sci-fi and action movie by the Wachowski sisters about the nature of reality.

items.title: Non-human person
items.text: Personhood granted to non-human beings (such as great apes, for instance) is an on-going debate, and a common occurence in sci-fi for alien species and robots/AIs.

items.title: This Is How You Lose the Time War
items.text: One of my favorite books. There's transhumanism, time travel, a sapphic romance… It has it all.
